descriptions.it: Descrizione Noi di Sunrise Pensi in grande, andiamo oltre e creiamo cose nuove. Per noi cultura del lavoro significa: realizzare grandi cose insieme. è qui vero rispetto e le nuove idee incontro un lavoro di squadra: ogni voce conta, ogni prospettiva ci rende più forti. La nostra passione ci spinge a provare cose nuove e a crescere. Sembri te? Allora diventa parte della nostra storia di successo. I nostri eroi in prima linea sono i fiori all’occhiello di Sunrise. Guadagnano punti con soluzioni su misura e un servizio eccellente, così ogni contatto con il cliente diventa una connessione a lungo termine. Mansioni - Sei il volto di Sunrise e ispiri i nostri clienti con il tuo carisma positivo, i tuoi consigli mirati e la vendita dei nostri diversi prodotti Sunrise. - Costruisci rapporti a lungo termine con i clienti e garantisci un'atmosfera di prima classe nel negozio. - Supporti i clienti con problemi di riparazione e assistenza e agisci in modo professionale e orientale alla soluzione. - Tieni traccia del magazzino e dell'inventario e svolgi le attività amministrative in modo efficiente. - Vivi e rappresentai i valori Sunrise: innovazione, vicinanza al cliente e servizio eccellente. • Requisiti - Hai completato la formazione nel settore della vendita al dettaglio, idealmente con esperienza nel settore delle telecomunicazioni o multimediale - oppure è un motivato al cambio di carriera con talento per la vendita. - No Essere traboccante di entusiasmo per la tecnologia, le telecomunicazioni e le tendenze digitali. - La tua passione per le vendite è evidente e il tuo comportamento professionale render un vero professionista delle vendite. - Ti piace avere a che fare con le persone e hai la capacità di riconoscere rapidamente i loro occhi. - Grazie alla tua pazienza e comprensione tecnica, nascerai un quotidiano per i nostri clienti. - Hai la flessibilità necessaria per lavorare a turni in un negozio aperto sette giorni su sette, inclusi turni serali e nei fine settimana regolari. - Hai un'ottima conoscenza del tedesco, qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva è un vantaggio. • Cosa offriamo In Sunrise lavorerai in un ambiente intermedio e multinazionale dove ogni voce viene ascoltata, le prospettive successive e i valori vengono vissuti. Per noi la diversità non è solo un programma, ma parte del nostro DNA. Di protagonista preferito le nostre differenze, idea reali grandi cose insieme. Sunrise è partner di “Advance Gender Equality in Business”, titolare del marchio svizzero LGBTI e certificata con “Fair-ON-Pay Advanced” per la parità di retribuzione per un lavoro di uguale valore per tutti. Sei pronto per la sfida? Allora entra a far parte del team e plasma attivamente il nostro futuro! #ChallengersWanted Contatto Nota per le agenzie: i documenti di candidatura o caricati da agenzie di collocamento o simili non sono desiderati e quindi non verranno presi in considerazione e verranno eliminati. #LI-TW1 #

For us work culture means: achieving great things together. here is true respect and new ideas meet teamwork: every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion drives us to try new things and grow. Does it sound like you? Then it becomes part of our success story. Our frontline heroes are the flagships of Sunrise. They earn points with tailor-made solutions and excellent service, so every customer contact becomes a long-term connection. Duties - You are the face of Sunrise and inspire our customers with your positive charisma, targeted advice and sales of our different Sunrise products. - Build long-term relationships with customers and ensure a first-class atmosphere in the store. - You support customers with repair and service issues and act in a professional and solution-oriented manner. - Track your warehouse and inventory and carry out administrative tasks efficiently. - Live and represent the Sunrise values: innovation, customer proximity and excellent service. • Requirements - You have completed training in the retail sector, ideally with experience in the telecommunications or multimedia sector - or are a motivated career changer with a knack for selling. - No Be overflowing with enthusiasm for technology, telecommunications and digital trends. - Your passion for sales is evident and your professional demeanor will make you a true sales professional. - You enjoy dealing with people and have the ability to quickly recognize their eyes. - Thanks to your patience and technical understanding, you will create a newspaper for our customers. - You have the flexibility to work shifts in a store that is open seven days a week, including regular evening and weekend shifts. - You have excellent knowledge of German, any additional language is a plus. • What we offer At Sunrise you will work in an intermediary, multinational environment where every voice is heard, subsequent perspectives and values ​​are lived. For us, diversity is not just a program, but part of our DNA. Favorite protagonist our differences, real idea of ​​great things together. Sunrise is a partner of “Advance Gender Equality in Business”, owner of the Swiss LGBTI brand and certified with “Fair-ON-Pay Advanced” for equal pay for work of equal value for all. Are you ready for the challenge? descriptions.it:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

At ADAO (AI, Data and Agentic Enablement Office), we bring people together to unlock the future of Sunrise through data, analytics, AI, and agentic technologies. We think big, move with purpose, and turn ideas into real impact for our customers and teams. ADAO is where innovation meets trust: we build strong data foundations, scale safe and reliable AI capabilities, and empower business units through a hub‑and‑spoke operating model to deliver meaningful results across the company. Within this model, you will work as part of the Agentic Enablement and Prompt Engineering & Conversation Design team, where the central hub provides standards, platforms, architecture, and best practices, while cross‑functional, outcome‑driven Pods are embedded in and led by the business. You will act as an engineering expert, partnering closely with the business to deliver on their priorities and outcomes.

In this role you will design, build, deploy and operate production grade ML and GenAI solutions, including RAG components where applicable, that deliver measurable business value for Sunrise, ensuring end-to-end lifecycle excellence from experimentation to automated deployment, monitoring, risk controls and continuous improvement in alignment with ADAO standards and governance.

You will be part of the central AI/ML Engineering & MLOps chapter within the ADAO Hub, supporting embedded Domain Pods through reusable platform components, engineering standards and hands-on delivery.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Develop & industrialize ML/GenAI solutions: Translate business roadmaps into solution designs while implementing robust training/inference pipelines and production services that meet all non‑functional requirementsCo-design solution architectures with Data Scientists and Domain Pods (batch/real-time, APIs, RAG patterns where relevant)Industrialize prototypes: automated tests, secure packaging, deployment/rollback, and performance/cost tuning
- Co-design solution architectures with Data Scientists and Domain Pods (batch/real-time, APIs, RAG patterns where relevant)
- Industrialize prototypes: automated tests, secure packaging, deployment/rollback, and performance/cost tuning

- Own & evolve MLOps/LLMOps pipelines: Build standardized CI/CD workflows, manage model promotion through dev→test→prod, and maintain monitoring and drift/retraining mechanismsMaintain standard CI/CD/CT templates incl. model/prompt packaging, validation gates, and dev→test→prod promotionOperate model registry/versioning and automated retraining triggers aligned to ADAO governance and CIO/IT change windows
- Maintain standard CI/CD/CT templates incl. model/prompt packaging, validation gates, and dev→test→prod promotion
- Operate model registry/versioning and automated retraining triggers aligned to ADAO governance and CIO/IT change windows

- Operate experimentation & feature management: Provide reproducible experimentation, manage feature store patterns and validation, and promote reusable datasets/features across PodsProvide experiment tracking, dataset/feature versioning and feature-store patterns (offline/online parity)Run evaluation harnesses for ML & GenAI (regression, A/B tests, safety & multilingual checks) and share reusable assets
- Provide experiment tracking, dataset/feature versioning and feature-store patterns (offline/online parity)
- Run evaluation harnesses for ML & GenAI (regression, A/B tests, safety & multilingual checks) and share reusable assets

- Model documentation, governance & risk: Produce compliant model documentation, implement required governance/security/privacy controls, and support GenAI safety and auditability measuresProduce model cards and compliance artefacts (data sources, limitations, privacy/bias controls) and evidence for auditsImplement Responsible AI / GenAI guardrails: grounding, HITL approvals, audit logs, and risk reviews with governance teams
- Produce model cards and compliance artefacts (data sources, limitations, privacy/bias controls) and evidence for audits
- Implement Responsible AI / GenAI guardrails: grounding, HITL approvals, audit logs, and risk reviews with governance teams

- Observability, reliability & incident response: Implement full observability for models and services, maintain runbooks and alerting, participate in incident resolution, and drive reliability improvementsDefine SLOs/SLIs and implement monitoring/alerting for quality, drift, latency, availability and costMaintain runbooks, participate in on-call/incident postmortems, and drive corrective actions
- Define SLOs/SLIs and implement monitoring/alerting for quality, drift, latency, availability and cost
- Maintain runbooks, participate in on-call/incident postmortems, and drive corrective actions

- Enablement & reusable components: Provide reusable ML/GenAI components, coach teams on MLOps/LLMOps best practices and ensure consistent engineering standards across Hub and PodsBuild reusable libraries and reference implementations (RAG connectors, evaluation utilities, deployment scaffolding)Coach Pod engineers through reviews, pairing and clinics; contribute to ADAO AI Academy materials
- Build reusable libraries and reference implementations (RAG connectors, evaluation utilities, deployment scaffolding)
- Coach Pod engineers through reviews, pairing and clinics; contribute to ADAO AI Academy materials

- Key deliverables (illustrative):Standard ML/LLMOps pipeline template + reference architectures (batch/real-time/RAG)Model registry & artefact versioning (models, prompts, datasets, features)Monitoring dashboards + drift detection + SLO reportingGenAI evaluation test suite (regression, safety, multilingual) and acceptance thresholdsModel documentation pack and operational runbooks (audit-ready)
- Standard ML/LLMOps pipeline template + reference architectures (batch/real-time/RAG)
- Model registry & artefact versioning (models, prompts, datasets, features)
- Monitoring dashboards + drift detection + SLO reporting
- GenAI evaluation test suite (regression, safety, multilingual) and acceptance thresholds
- Model documentation pack and operational runbooks (audit-ready)

YOUR SKILLS:

- Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience
- 3+ years in ML engineering, MLOps, software/data engineering or related roles, with proven end-to-end production of ML/GenAI solutions
- Hands‑on CI/CD and DevOps for ML workloads (testing, version control, release management), plus IaC (Terraform/Pulumi) and GitOps
- Experience with ML frameworks (scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) and serving patterns (REST/gRPC, batch, streaming), and MLOps tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, Vertex AI, SageMaker)
- Strong Python software engineering (testing, APIs), containers (Docker) and cloud deployment patterns; GenAI/RAG experience is a plus
- Familiarity with feature stores, experiment tracking, data quality testing and orchestration tools (Airflow/Dagster/Prefect), working in cross-functional Hub and Pod setups
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, ownership mindset and reliability under pressure with a structured engineering approach
- Ability to influence without formal authority, champion standards across Hub and Pods, and continuously adapt to evolving AI/ML technologies; telecommunications experience is a plus

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together. Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value. Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future! #ChallengersWanted Information for agencies: Application dossiers sent or uploaded by placement agencies or similar are not desired, will therefore not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-SJ1

As the B2B Prevention & Retention Manager, you are responsible for proactively identifying at-risk customers and deploying targeted retention strategies and campaigns, with special offers to reduce churn. You will leverage data insights, customer behavior, and close collaboration with B2B Frontline Retention, Base Management, Analytics, and NPS teams to drive retention initiatives, ensuring long-term customer satisfaction and value.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Customer Segmentation – Develop segmentation strategies to personalize prevention actions and increase offer relevance and effectiveness
- Performance Monitoring – Track the impact of prevention activities and offers; continuously refine strategies based on KPIs and feedback
- Cross-functional Collaboration – Work closely with Base Management, Retention Frontline, NPS Team and Marketing to align retention tactics, share customer insights and solve customer interactions.
- Customer Insights & Reporting – Analyze customer feedback, usage trends, and churn reasons to support data-driven decision-making
- Process Optimization – Continuously improve churn prevention workflows, tools, and automation for scalability and efficiency

YOUR SKILLS:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field
- Proven experience (3+ years) in customer retention, Base Management, Value Management, or related field
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and customer behavior patterns
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with a customer-centric mindset
- Ability to work cross-functionally and drive initiatives in a fast-paced environment
- Strategic thinker with hands-on execution ability and a proactive approach to problem-solving

descriptions.de:
Bei Sunrise denken wir grösser, gehen weiter und schaffen Neues. Für uns bedeutet Arbeitskultur: gemeinsam Grosses schaffen. Hier treffen Respekt und frische Ideen auf echtes Teamwork – jede Stimme zählt, jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, Neues zu wagen und ständig zu wachsen. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für alle MySports IT- & OTT-Systeme und stellst sicher, dass diese für den operativen Betrieb reibungslos funktionieren. Zudem verantwortest du die Weiterentwicklung unserer gesamten Systemlandschaft.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Streaming-Technologie, App-Entwicklung, CRM und Broadcast und sorgst dafür, dass alle Systeme optimal zusammenspielen. DEINE CHALLENGE:

- Technische Verantwortung & Betrieb:Sicherstellung eines stabilen und reibungslosen Betriebs der MySports App und aller angebundenen Systeme inkl. Monitoring der Systemperformance sowie proaktive Identifikation und Eskalation von Issues (insbesondere bei Live-Events)
- Systemintegration & Datenflüsse:Verantwortung für das Zusammenspiel der gesamten Systemlandschaft sowie Sicherstellung sauberer Datenflüsse zwischen App, CRM und Backend-Systemen inkl. Schnittstellenverantwortung zur OTT-Plattform sowie zu Broadcast-, Content- und EPG-Systemen
- Solution Design & Requirements Engineering:Übersetzung von Business-Anforderungen in klare, umsetzbare technische Requirements sowie Sicherstellung einer strukturierten und vollständigen Anforderungsdefinition
- Vendor Setup & Steuerung:Federführende Auswahl sowie Koordination und Steuerung externer Technologiepartner und Lieferanten (z. B. App, CRM, Payment, Analytics) in Abstimmung mit Procurement, Legal und Security
- Implementation & Delivery Management:End-to-End Verantwortung für die Einführung, Integration und Weiterentwicklung von Systemen und Features inkl. Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von Testing (inkl. UAT) bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live
- Go-Live & Operational Handover:Übergabe neuer Systeme und Features an Operations inkl. Dokumentation sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen Betriebs und Begleitung der initialen Betriebsphase
- Weiterentwicklung & Optimierung:Verantwortung für die Gesamtübersicht der Systemlandschaft inkl. Identifikation von Optimierungsbedarf, Definition und kontinuierliche Optimierung von technischen Prozessen sowie Evaluation neuer Technologien (z. B. im Bereich OTT, Automatisierung, AI)

DEINE SKILLS:

- Erfahrung in einer technischen Produktmanager-, Plattform- oder System-Integrationsrolle
- Gutes Verständnis von OTT-/Streaming-Plattformen; Verständnis von digitalen Subscription-Modellen von Vorteil
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit APIs & Systemintegrationen sowie CRM-, Payment- oder Analytics-Systemen
- Grundverständnis von Datenstrukturen, Datenflüssen sowie Software-Development-Prozessen (Agile, Releases, Testing)
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Requirements Engineering inkl. Priorisierung und Stakeholder-Management
- Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Themen verständlich zu vermitteln
- Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein („Ownership“) sowie proaktive und hands-on Mentalität
- Fähigkeit, verschiedene Stakeholder (Business, Tech, externe Partner) zu koordinieren
- Interesse an neuen Technologien (insb. OTT, CRM, Automatisierung, AI)
- Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bei Sunrise arbeitest du in einem dynamischen und multinationalen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört, Perspektiven geteilt und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Grosses.

Sunrise ist Partner von «Advance Gender Equality in Business», Träger des Schweizer LGBTI-Labels und mit «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» für die gleiche Bezahlung gleichwertiger Arbeit für alle zertifiziert.

descriptions.fr: Une aube, penser plus grand, aller au-delà et créer de nouvelles choses. Pour nous, la culture de travail signifie créer de grandes choses ensemble. Ici le respect et les idées qui précèdent le travail d'équipe réelle. Chaque voix compte, chaque perspective nous rend plus forts. Notre passion nous pousse à oser de nouvelles choses et à grandir. Est-ce que cela semble? Alors une partie de notre histoire de réussite. Nos héros de première ligne sont l'addiction de Sunrise. Vous êtes le visage de Sunrise et inspirez nos clients avec votre charisme positif, vos conseils ciblés et la vente de nos différents produits Sun1. - Construisez des relations avec les clients à long terme et fournir une atmosphère de première classe dans le magasin. - Soutenez les clients avec des problèmes de réparation et de service et agissez professionnellement et de manière a priori à la solution. - Suivez les tâches d'inventaire et d'administration efficacement. - Vivi et moi avons représenté les valeurs de Sun1 - innovation, proximité client et excellent service. Vos assassinats : - Vous avez terminé un apprentissage dans le commerce de détail, idéalement expérimenté dans l'industrie des télécommunications ou multimédia. ou est un adversaire de côté motivé avec une touche de vente. - Avec l'enthousiasme pour la technologie, les télécommunications et les tendances numériques. - Votre passion pour les ventes est évidente et votre apparence professionnelle fait de vous un véritable professionnel de vente. - Vous aimez traiter avec les gens et la capacité de reconnaître rapidement leurs yeux. - Grâce à votre patience et à votre compréhension technique, vous deviendrez un héros quotidien pour nos clients. - Vous avez une bonne connaissance de l'allemand, toutes les autres langues sont un atout. - Apportez beaucoup de flexibilité, de fiabilité et d'ouverture à une industrie en évolution rapide.
